name: Super Bowl
seo_title: Super Bowl Charcuterie Board Ideas (Football + Snack Stadium)
description: Super Bowl charcuterie board ideas: a football-shaped board, a snack stadium for a crowd, a halftime Valentine's board, a refill plan, and how much to buy.
answer: A Super Bowl board is party food that has to last four quarters: plan about 3 oz each of cheese and meat per guest, lean on hearty, salty things (cheddar, pepperoni, pretzels, dips), and set out a fresh round at halftime. A football-shaped board gets the photos. Super Bowl LXI is on February 14, 2027, so this year it falls on Valentine's Day.

ideas.title: The Football Board
ideas.text: An oval of salami and sharp cheddar with a strip of white cheese for the laces, surrounded by pretzels, crackers, pickled jalapeños and a honey-mustard dip.

ideas.title: The Snack Stadium
ideas.text: Build a stadium from a rectangle of bowls: dips and salsa as the field, chips and crackers as the stands, and cheese, meat and vegetables as the crowd. It feeds a room without a single plated dish.

ideas.title: The Halftime Valentine Board
ideas.for: Game day meets date night · 4 guests
ideas.text: With the game on February 14, do both: pepperoni and cheddar for the first half, then strawberries, dark chocolate and a heart cut from a slice of cheese for the second.

shapes.name: Football Board
steps: Lay an oval of folded salami and sliced cheddar on a large board.
Run a strip of white cheese down the middle, with short cross pieces for the laces.
Fill the edges with pretzels, crackers and small bowls of dip.

shapes.name: Halftime Heart
steps: Lay a heart outline of crackers on a round or square board.
Fill one half with game-day snacks (pepperoni, cheddar) and the other with strawberries and chocolate.
Set a small bowl of dip or honey in the middle.

plan.what: Buy crackers, chips, pretzels, nuts and jarred dips and pickles.
Buy cheese, meat and vegetables. Make any homemade dips.
Cube cheese, fold meats, cut vegetables, fill the dip bowls and pack a halftime refill tray. Cover and chill.
Take cheese out of the fridge and build the board.
Swap in the refill tray. Anything perishable that has been out 2 hours goes back in the fridge or in the bin.

faq.q: What goes on a Super Bowl charcuterie board?
faq.a: Hearty, salty snacks that hold up for hours: sharp cheddar and pepper jack, pepperoni, salami and summer sausage, pretzels, tortilla chips, crackers, pickles and pickled jalapeños, and two or three dips.

faq.q: How much charcuterie do I need for a Super Bowl party?
faq.a: A game-day board is usually the party food, so plan about 3 oz each of cheese and meat per guest and 10 to 12 crackers or chips. For 20 guests that's about 4¼ lb of each, including the 10% buffer.
Sunday, February 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California. It's the first Super Bowl played on Valentine's Day, so a board that does both is an easy win.

faq.q: How do you make a football-shaped charcuterie board?
faq.a: Lay an oval of folded salami and sliced cheddar on a large board, then run a strip of white cheese (mozzarella or provolone) down the middle with short cross pieces for the laces. Fill in around it with pretzels, crackers and dips.

faq.q: How long can a game-day board sit out?
faq.a: No more than 2 hours for anything perishable (1 hour above 90°F). A game runs longer than that, so build the board at kickoff and swap in a refill tray from the fridge at halftime.
